text:
Yesterday, I felt sick. I had pain in my head and my body felt hot. My mother looked at me and said, 'You need to see a doctor.'

We went to the hospital in the morning. The doctor checked my eyes, ears, nose, mouth, and hair. She also listened to my heart. Then she looked at my arm and my leg because they hurt too. The doctor said, 'You are not very sick, but you need medicine and rest.'

She gave me medicine to take after food. My mother took me home, and I went to bed. I did not go to school. I stayed home and rested all day. I didn't brush my tooth in the evening because I was too tired, but I did it in the morning.

After three days, I felt healthy again. The doctor said exercise is good for a healthy body, so now I walk every morning. I wash my hands often too, so I don't get sick again. Taking care of your body is very important. A healthy body makes a happy life!
